label: tp-tc-gate-probe3
_why: The third launch of the trade-centre gate probe (user 2026-10-19: 'Go on with the probes'). The first gated run (session 20261019_172655, run 3) set the engine's two base thresholds to 0, which the engine rejects at load; the second (20261019_174541) set them to 1 / 1, and the engine rejected NON_MARKET_CAPITAL again ('Must be greater than 1': it must exceed MARKET_CAPITAL), so every non-capital state, every treaty port among them, kept vanilla's 500k. Both were stopped. This book sets 1 / 2, which preflight L33 now passes (and fails on 1 / 1). Same two questions as tp_tc_gate_probe.json: does the scripted gate cost tick time, and do treaty ports now get trade centres while the rest of the world builds as before.

_arms.tpd4-tcg: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-dpriv-wm99-tpd4-tcg.json} - the tpd4 treaty-port book + ai_defines TRADE_CENTER_MINIMUM_GDP_MARKET_CAPITAL 1 / _NON_MARKET_CAPITAL 2 (the engine gate off) + the script gate in the trade centre's can_build (vanilla's thresholds, treaty ports and players' government construction exempt) + a yearly PMR_TCG log; + telemetry

_comparison: Tick cost: against tpd4 runs 1-2 of 20261019_172655 (same book minus the gate, same afternoon, 1836-1841; tools/testbed/ledger/arm_tick_cost.mjs --ref tpd4 --to 1841). Trade centres: at 1837 / 1841 against those runs, and at 1846 against 20261019_013756_tp-driver-prod4-10y (the tpd4 book, 2 x 1836->1846).

_predictions.tick cost: within +-3% of tpd4 per in-game year; above +5% means the engine's warning ('decreasing these can adversely affect performance') bites
_predictions.treaty ports: ports with zero trade capacity in the tpd4 runs carry some by 1846; Hong Kong and Singapore (GDP far under 500k) gain levels sooner
_predictions.elsewhere: world trade-centre levels and states with trade capacity within ~10% of tpd4's

_stop_rule: none: two fixed runs (a mechanism and tick-cost probe, read in full).
_caveats: A 10-year probe: early-game readings only; the price effect (F245 link 3) is not measured here.
The reference tpd4 runs are from other sessions the same day (an early reading, so cross-session drift is small but not zero).
The observer's autosaves overwrite the user's autosave slots (they hold only today's probe saves; named saves are untouched).
Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30). Watch with short reads only (L29).
